curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Q wants out to spin a DJ gig on the night of the heist, but Bishop has the gun and refuses to take no for an answer.
curatedMovie.description: In Harlem, four friends escalate from petty offenses to robbing a store. When armed crew leader Bishop demands absolute commitment, aspiring DJ Q finds his musical ambitions clashing with lethal street stakes.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast, heavy, and relentlessly suspenseful; a volatile Harlem crime drama charged with mounting dread.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This crime drama follows four friends whose planned convenience-store robbery clashes with Q’s hopes of becoming a DJ.
